notes: MG1655 wild type with 5 antidepressants (2 h, 25 C, 120 rpm) and an unnamed 'Mutant' with antibiotics (tetracycline, ciprofloxacin, amoxicillin, chloramphenicol). Mutant genotype not described: genotype_class/perturbed genes left out; mutant controls are not reference-genotype so is_control false. Growth protocol says LB at 30 C but the treatment protocol says 25 C for the WT 2 h exposure; WT samples given 25 C, mutant samples (protocol not described) left without temperature, exposure and culture mode. No growth phase given. WT re-read: MG1655 WT -> wild_type.
